description: 30 text-only (no style guide) eval items (2026-07-22). Each = one real base form (text-track-created.json) + one styling prompt, classified on four axes: detail (simple|detailed), layoutTheme (none|layout-only|theme-only|both), formContext (agnostic|domain-aware), phrasing (polished|messy). Distribution: 20 simple / 10 detailed; 12 domain-aware (40%); 4 messy (20% of simple). Simple layout cells use basic layouts (question-by-question, single page); detailed use complex layouts. Vibe words count as theme (max 3).
